{{Top|leg}}
An '''upgraded galven pattern''' was a modification that could be made to a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster's]] [[galven pattern]].

The modification allowed for the power of a blasters galven pattern to be amplified, with the galven pattern itself being formed by a static-pulse field created by micro-electronics built into the barrel of a blaster: galven circuitry. The circuitry could be remodulated by removing a blasters barrel; at the end of the barrel, three static pulse adaptors interface between the galven circuitry and the [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]]. Interfacing the adaptor prongs to a computer system or [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] allows for the circuitry to be remodulated from factory standards to allow for more powerful focusing patterns.

The galven circuitry could many times be remodulated to allow for a significant boost in power - equalling that of a medium blasters output, in addition to the blasters current output. However, bypassing factory settings was hazardous to the blaster itself; many times the blaster would melt from the increase of heat and energy. Because of this, a blaster equipped with upgraded galven patterns was much more lethal than an unmodified blaster, at the cost of a much shorter operational life.
